  - button "Read the inscriptions"
  - img "The Great Wave, a woodblock print of boats beneath a towering wave, with Mount Fuji in the distance."
  - paragraph:
    - text: Woodblock print.
    - link "The Metropolitan Museum of Art, JP2569":

notes.text: The rectangle names the series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji and the print Under the Wave off Kanagawa.

calibration.reason: The described intake is legible and clearly labeled, but familiar in layout; misplaced focus after invalid input is a material usability weakness.

primary_action.observed: The print was replaced by an enlarged detail and translations; the focused button changed to Return to the print.

A-1440.edge_observation: Enter returned to the full print with a clearly visible gold focus outline on Read the inscriptions.
A-1440.fact_check: The rectangular vertical inscription is matched to A, the title cartouche, and the separate writing to its left to B, the signature. The displayed translations name Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji and Under the Wave off Kanagawa, and say Hokusai was working as Iitsu. The A and B badges and short lines are placed over the image surface, though they appear to avoid the principal ink characters. The translations were not independently verified through a source in this review.
A-1440.strength: The enlarged detail makes the two original marks easy to distinguish.
A-1440.weakness: A wide gap separates the detail from its explanations, increasing back-and-forth scanning. The miniature locator and its outline are small.
A-1440.repair: Bring the explanations closer and enlarge the locator; keep annotation marks outside the artwork.

primary_action.observed: The detail and translations appeared side by side immediately, with focus on Return to the print.

A-390.edge_observation: Enter restored the print and the focused button retained a visible gold outline.
A-390.fact_check: The boxed writing corresponds to A and the separate left-hand inscription to B; the displayed translations give the series and print titles and Hokusai's Iitsu name. Badges sit on the artwork, apparently clear of the main characters. Translation accuracy was not independently verified.
A-390.strength: The full detail and both explanations fit in the initial viewport.
A-390.weakness: The narrow columns make the text wrap heavily and shrink the original marks; the locator outline is difficult to read, and the title and date wrap awkwardly.
A-390.repair: Give the detail and text more width, enlarge the locator, and adjust the header layout at this width.

primary_action.observed: The enlarged detail and translations appeared; the focused button changed to Return to the print.

B-1440.edge_observation: Enter restored the print and left a visible gold focus outline on Read the inscriptions.
B-1440.fact_check: A aligns with the rectangular title cartouche and B with the separate signature to its left. The displayed text translates these as the series and print titles and Hokusai's Iitsu name. The large-detail badges sit outside the image, so they do not cover its original marks; the small overview has an added outline over the print. Translation accuracy was not independently verified.
B-1440.strength: The explanations are closer to the enlarged detail and the exterior badges leave its ink unobstructed.
B-1440.weakness: The small badges are detached from the specific marks, so matching still requires scanning; the miniature locator outline is difficult to discern.
B-1440.repair: Use clearer exterior pointers and enlarge the locator while preserving the unobstructed detail.

primary_action.observed: The detail and translations appeared side by side immediately, with focus on Return to the print.

B-390.edge_observation: Enter restored the print with a visible gold focus outline on the button.
B-390.fact_check: A is above the boxed title inscription and B below the separate left-hand signature; the displayed text gives the title translations and the Iitsu name. The detail badges are outside the artwork, but the overview contains an added outline. Translation accuracy was not independently verified.
B-390.strength: The exterior badges leave the enlarged artwork unobscured, and the keyboard toggle works.
B-390.weakness: A and B are separated from their marks vertically, especially B below the image, raising scan burden. The detail and locator are small, and the text wraps in a narrow column.
B-390.repair: Use larger, clearly connected exterior labels and a wider detail or stacked layout; enlarge the locator.

preference.reason: At desktop width B places the explanations closer to the detail and keeps its badges outside the artwork. Both designs work by keyboard, but both need a more legible locator and a less cramped mobile layout.
